faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services
faq.q1: What are Scopus and Web of Science?
faq.a1: Scopus and Web of Science (WoS) are the two leading international citation databases for peer-reviewed literature. Publishing in journals indexed in these databases is an international standard of research quality and is highly valued in academic performance evaluations.
faq.a2: Click "Sign Up" at the top right, enter your name, email, and password. Registration is free and takes less than a minute. Once signed in, you can immediately submit a consultation.
faq.q3: Is there a fee for consultation?
faq.a3: Yes, each service has fees depending on scope and complexity. The rates shown on the services page are indicative. Final fees will be communicated after the initial assessment.
faq.q4: How long does the consultation take?
faq.a4: Duration varies based on the chosen service and manuscript status. Typically, manuscript reviews take 3–7 business days, while comprehensive mentoring can take several weeks until the manuscript is submission-ready.
faq.a5: Yes, we serve individuals (lecturers, graduate students, researchers) and institutions (universities, research centers, LPPM). Institutional packages are available. Contact us via WhatsApp for further discussion.
faq.q6: How can I contact the Scientia Advantage team?
faq.a6: You can contact us via WhatsApp, email info@scopus-wos-consultant.com, or through the contact form on this website. Our team responds within 1 business day.
